name: cn.yyxx.eyuancomm.core.impl.floatball.FloatCenterService
description: The Eyuan (YYXXGame) game communication SDK binds this Service to display a floating menu on the game screen; its configured entries open the member center, game-service links, recharge and invitation pages, or account switching.
disableEffect: Disabling it removes those floating entries, including the member and recharge links, from the game screen.
